issue.title: Pager label-prefix key still costs 0.1-3.8s CPU at 2k-100k lines, missing the 10ms target

task_type_fields.impact: On a large `sase pager` / `sase bead show` / ACE-embedded pager document, pressing a link label key can stall the UI for 0.5-3.8s of CPU. That breaks the epic goal that pagers respond in time proportional to what is on screen.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/pager/_screen_actions_labels.py (label-prefix key path); tests/perf/bench_pager.py label_a case
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by sase-1es.6 (notes #3/#4) and sase-1es.8 (note #7) during epic sase-1es (plan:202610/pager_performance.md). The plan set a target of 10 ms or less for a label-prefix key at 20k lines (phase virtual-body-widget). The epic missed it, and per the plan's guardrails a missed target becomes a follow-up rather than a trade-off.

Measured with `just bench-pager` (tests/perf/bench_pager.py, label_a case: one label-prefix key, CPU above the trivial-app floor):
- master baseline (sase-1es.1): 2k 0.24-1.71s CPU
- after the epic (sase-1es.8, 2026-10-03): 2k 0.10s (code-sparse) / 1.51s (log-dense); 20k 3.41s (code-sparse) / 0.57s (log-dense)
- 100k log-dense (sase-1es.6 #4): 3.77s with navigated=false

Every other navigation key now has a median of 0-12ms above the floor at 20k, so the label path is the remaining O(document) keystroke. Counter tests in tests/pager/test_body_widget.py show that a label prefix relayouts 0 lines and repaints at most a viewport. The remaining cost is therefore outside the virtual body: label map building, label-layer/target-span work, or (for code-sparse, where single-character labels can navigate) target resolution/navigation that the bench counts as part of the key. First, split the bench's label_a into "prefix only" and "navigate", then profile the larger one.

Repro: `just bench-pager --cases code-sparse,log-dense --ladder 2000,20000 --no-cold`, then read the label_a rows.

issue.creation_reason: Epic sase-1es virtualized the pager body, but its label-prefix key target (<=10ms at 20k) was missed in both the sase-1es.6 and sase-1es.8 benches; the epic plan routes missed targets to follow-ups.

payload.description: Same sase-1es bench misses; label-prefix key cost is tracked separately
